questions.stem: Let $L=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\2&1\end{pmatrix}$ and $U=\begin{pmatrix}3&4\\0&5\end{pmatrix}$. What is the bottom-right entry of the product $LU$?
questions.explain: The entry is row 2 of L dotted with column 2 of U: 2·4 + 1·5 = 13.

questions.stem: Solve 2x = 6, then put that x into 3x + 2y = 13. What is y?
questions.explain: From 2x = 6 we get x = 3. Then 9 + 2y = 13, so 2y = 4 and y = 2.

questions.stem: An upper triangular matrix has 2, 3 and 4 down its diagonal. What is its determinant?
questions.explain: For a triangular matrix the determinant is the product of the diagonal entries: 2 × 3 × 4 = 24.

questions.stem: Apply R2 → R2 − 2·R1 to the rows R1 = [1 3 | 5] and R2 = [2 7 | 12]. What is the new R2?
questions.explain: Subtract 2·R1 = [2 6 | 10] from R2 in every column, including the right-hand side: [0 1 | 2].
